data.body: REOPENED: the script-self-commit fix (commit 11902029eb) was reverted from chunk 3. Manual opus review (FP-recovery PR #580, hash 4af1ce6876) found it: (CRITICAL) new Test 8 fails under the standard bash test runner because the script's git add/commit exit 128 and are swallowed by '|| true', so DESIGN.md is never committed; and (IMPORTANT) a raw 'git commit' from a data-transform script during an active session violates rule:raw-commit and rule:no-session-direct-commit. The proper fix is a DESIGN DECISION (route migration output through the session's normal commit flow / a one-time setup step, NOT a raw commit in the script). Reclassified as NEEDS_GUIDANCE.
